turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, thank you for contacting AcmeBrands.  How can I help today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Well, I'm always buying my boyfriend stuff from you all, so I have a lot of past orders.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I want to buy him a pair of boots, but I can't remember if he already has them.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I forgot my password, so I can't log in and I tried so many times that the page froze.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help reset your password for you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I have your full name or account ID please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.  Albert Sanders

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Account has been pulled up for Albert Sanders.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you Albert - can I also have your username?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: sure.  it's albertsanders958

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: Details of albertsanders958 have been entered.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: OK, I won't be able to recover your old password, but I can generate a new one for you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: All I will need is your PIN or the answer to your security question.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, let me check my planner for the PIN.  Hold on

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Finally!!  761920

turns.speaker: system_action
turns.text: A password has been generated.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great - I have generated a new password for you: 6qwgznj4c07

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please use this one going forward, in the event you remember your old password it will no longer be valid.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait!  Let me try and log in while I still have you!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No problem.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It worked, THANK GOD!!!!!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can I help with anything else?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No.  I'm ready to go!!  Thank you, dear!!!

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you and have a great day!
